name: Hoisin Shrimp, Pineapple & Cabbage Stir-Fry with Rice Noodles

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Place in a large bowl.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Add to the bowl with the pineapple.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pineapple, shrimp, onion, garlic, shredded cabbage, and salt. Stir-fry until the pineapple is tender and shrimp are cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the shrimp are done, add noodles, hoisin sauce, and water to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup hoisin sauce
½ cup water

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
